What is Bidders Highway?

Bidders Highway is an online auction platform for enthusiast vehicles – everything from vintage and collector cars to sports cars, convertibles and motorcycles that have that little something extra. We are built around an active community of car and motorcycle nerds like ourselves and want to be the campfire where people meet, share knowledge and find items that are often not seen in the rest of the market.
October 01, 2025 10:00

This is Bidders Highway

In Sweden, approximately 75,000 vehicles in this category are sold annually – our platform makes buying and selling smooth, fast and transparent.

We offer a lightweight model compared to more traditional auction houses: curated selection, professional photos and documentation, 7-day bidding, BankID and binding bids for a secure transaction. All items are selected by our team, while the seller guarantees condition – a balance that provides more security than a classified ad but retains the flexibility that enthusiasts have come to appreciate if our reviews are to be believed.

"Recommended! Simple, clear and no hassle." Anders, September 2025

"From the first contact to the photography, description of the car and the sale, Bidders Higway shows that they are both personal and professional. I can only give them the highest rating!" Erik L, July 2025
